cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Pick the Prize
cards.instruction: Make them choose which reward, principle, or relationship matters most when not everything can be kept.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Choose the trophy ceremony or our anniversary dinner. They're at the same time. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then you're choosing the trophy and postponing us. Say which.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It could be a short ceremony.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you leave before your name is called? That's the choice.

mechanism: A manages the anniversary booking around a ceremony conflict, offers next-day dinner and requires B to name which matters tonight.
confusable: Unlike demanding both events, A forces priority where the same-time commitments cannot both be kept.
comparison: A later celebration and leaving before trophy call differ from a prize-funded team trip.
seedUse: D202-a trophy and anniversary; S02-a offers rebooking while making the sacrificed evening explicit.
